description: Render a clip into a vertical short: captions burned in, auto-reframed to 9:16. Returns a jobId; poll get_clip until status is READY. Rendering is required before scheduling. The top clip of a new import may already be auto-rendering with default options; if this returns "already rendering", poll get_clip until READY, then call render_clip again to apply your own platform, hook or dub. If dub_language was set, check dubSkipped on the READY clip: true means the dub was unavailable and the original audio was kept. A dub needs dub_consent: true, which only the user can give: ask them to confirm they have the consent of the people whose voices will be dubbed (the clip is sent to a third-party AI voice service).

caption_language.description: Optional: translate captions to this language.

dub_consent.description: Required (true) with dub_language: the user confirms they have the consent of the people whose voices will be dubbed. Ask the user; never set it on their behalf.

dub_language.description: Optional: dub the audio into this language (ElevenLabs). Requires dub_consent. Can be skipped; see dubSkipped on get_clip.

hook_text.description: Optional headline burned over the first few seconds (max 120 chars).

reframe_focus.description: Horizontal focus of the 9:16 crop. "track" pans to follow the speaker's face.

name: render_clip
